headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 25, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a crucial 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Detroit Tigers also secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Tarik Skubal pitching 7.1 innings with 12 strikeouts and just 1 earned run. The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Spencer Arrighetti, a right-handed pitcher for the Houston Astros, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right foot nerve irritation. Juan Soto, a left fielder for the New York Mets, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left calf strain. The Cleveland Guardians have also placed right-handed pitcher Shawn Armstrong on the 15-day injured list due to a left calf strain.

The Kansas City Royals traded center fielder Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded right-handed pitcher Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for right-handed pitcher Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks edged out the Washington Nationals 3-2, securing a crucial win. Dylan Crews led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Zack Littell pitched 5 strong innings for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Impact hitters for the Royals included Carter Jensen, Salvador Perez, and Vinnie Pasquantino, while the Tigers' Riley Greene and Hao-Yu Lee stood out on offense.

top_news.title: **Astros RHP Spencer Arrighetti Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Spencer Arrighetti, a right-handed pitcher for the Houston Astros, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right foot nerve irritation. The injury occurred on July 25, 2026.

top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made their first trade of the season, sending CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash.
